7810.title: Platform-specific skill status hashes
7810.rootCauseOneLine: The server compares installed Windows-mode skill hashes with POSIX source hashes without platform normalization.

prReviews.verdict: Static diff addresses the verified mechanism; branch not executed.

7810.proposedFix: Compute platform-specific expected status hashes without changing the install manifest or daemon protocol.
7810.caveats: Server API reproduction using real files and simulated Windows daemon RPC; no native Windows installation or Settings browser check. Test and evidence are embedded inline under report repository policy.
